note: `cl-incf', 12 of the 35 packages and the most-reached `cl-' name kg can implement honestly. Emacs answers ((2 2) (6 6) 2.0): the form's value is the NEW value, the default increment is 1, an explicit X is used instead, and the arithmetic is ordinary so a float stays a float. Every place here is a bare SYMBOL, which is the whole of what kg supports -- Emacs takes any generalised variable and kg has no `gv'. Measured: of 212 `cl-incf' sites across ELPA, 188 pass a bare symbol.
